title: BTS Sukhumvit Line 3D — Authentic Bangkok City & Driver Simulator
description: A complete, self-contained interactive 3D Bangkok Skytrain simulator in vanilla HTML5/CSS3/ES6, rendered with Three.js r128 and OrbitControls. It models all 47 operational Sukhumvit Line stations from Khu Khot N24 to Kheha E23, four procedural city zones, elevated third-rail kinematics, a blue/white/red four-car BTS train with sliding doors and passenger exchange, an auto pilot, four cameras, a bilingual EN/TH transit HUD, PA-first door sequencing, 145 bundled Kanya-voice Thai PA clips with English system TTS, an audio mixer and Web Audio synthesis, plus a rain/thunderstorm scene.

build.includes: Initial Three.js foundation, route survey and viaduct, four-zone procedural city, 47 stations and platform furniture, Chatuchak, Victory Monument, Siam skywalk, Terminal 21, Benchasiri Park, Erawan elephant, Khu Khot depot, Kheha terminus, four-car blue/white/red BTS train with doors and interior, passenger boarding/alighting animation, bilingual telemetry HUD, minimap, station list, four cameras, auto pilot, door interlock, terminus reversal, quiet Web Audio traction, bilingual PA voice, transit music, audio mixer, rain/thunderstorm scene, time-of-day modes, mobile layout, 36-check self-test, documentation, screenshots and GitHub packaging.

features: 47 operational Sukhumvit Line stations, N24 Khu Khot to E23 Kheha (N6 Sena Ruam omitted as unopened)
Starts at either terminus: Khu Khot N24 or Kheha E23
Auto pilot on by default with a visible TAKE MANUAL takeover button
PA language selector: Thai + English, Thai only, or English only, with Thai voice status
Four procedural city zones: northern suburbs, central core, Sukhumvit corridor and southern delta
Zone-aware building density, heights, palettes, glass ratio, trees and landmarks
Elevated viaduct with deck, parapets, piers, ballastless track, running rails and a glowing third rail
47 side-platform stations with canopies, Thai/English name boards, benches, lamps, lifts, signals and waiting passengers

Four-car BTS train with blue lower body, white upper body, black window band, red-framed cab mask, gold emblem, BTS roundels, sliding doors, interior, bogies, headlights and orange LED destination displays
Throttle 0–100 km/h, service brake, emergency brake, coasting and door interlock
Auto pilot that accelerates, brakes, creeps to the stop mark, opens doors, waits for the passenger exchange, closes doors, departs and reverses at termini
Four cameras: driver cab, passenger scenic window, free orbit and platform arrival cam
Bilingual EN/TH HUD with station names, zone descriptions, toasts, announcements and control labels
Live telemetry: speed, distance, ETA, zone, interchange chips, nearby landmark, route progress and minimap
Clickable 47-station list and Next Stop jump control
Quiet high-frequency Web Audio traction whine, track thuds, door chime, PA chime, horn, brake squeal, city ambience, transit music, rain bed and thunder
Bilingual Thai/English PA voice following the BTS pattern: next station, interchange, station-name arrival, right-side door warning, mind-the-gap, doors-closing and terminal announcements
Station-specific nearby-place callouts for all 47 stations and the special Siam/Silom interchange announcement
145 bundled Kanya-voice Thai PA clips for next station, arrival, welcome and doors closing
PA-first door sequencing: doors wait for the current announcement to finish
Free orbit camera 3 as the default view
Three-beep door-closing warning
Audio mixer with independent engine, announcement and music levels plus PA voice and tourist-info toggles
Passenger exchange animation: alighting and boarding passengers walk between train doors and platform
PA-first door sequencing: opening waits for the arrival announcement and closing waits for the doors-closing announcement
Rain/thunderstorm scene with 3D rain, screen rain, wet glass, faster wipers, lightning and thunder
Day, golden hour and night modes with lit windows, neon billboards, stars and headlights, plus rain/thunderstorm
Landmarks: Chatuchak, Victory Monument, Siam Skywalk, Terminal 21, Benchasiri Park, Erawan Museum, Khu Khot Depot, Kheha Terminus, Wat Phra Sri Mahathat, ARL, Samrong Yellow Line and Pak Nam
Mobile layout with minimised telemetry and reflowed control dock
Built-in 36-check self-test at ?selftest=1
